column8: ["Both teal seats read as deep cups, with dark far inner walls and bright near rims; flatten them into broad, open seats viewed straight down.","The seat rims and brass connector have strong upper-to-lower shading that implies directional light; use symmetric tonal structure and even brass color.","The dark collars crowd both seats at their inward edges, making the connecting channel narrow and obstructed; simplify the bridge and keep the functional openings broad."]

["Both seats read as deep cups with visible far inner walls; flatten them into circular seats seen straight down.","The teal seats are dark at the top and bright at the bottom, and the brass link has a bright upper ridge; use symmetric tonal structure without a directional highlight.","The central brass channel is crowded by stacked collars and a raised middle block; simplify it into one broad, unobstructed connection between the seats."]

["Both seats are filled with teal domes that read as atoms; paint empty, broad circular sockets centered on the scaffold marks.","Both sockets have raised dark back walls and brighter front rims, making them read as tilted cups rather than straight-down circles.","The central brass connector is muddy and pinched between the sockets; give it a clear one-piece outline and a broad, unobstructed joining channel."]
